-P FORWARD ACCEPT
-P OUTPUT ACCEPT
-P POSTROUTING ACCEPT
-N OSSBOT-MSS-FWD
-N OSSBOT-MSS-IN
-N OSSBOT-MSS-OUT
-A INPUT -j OSSBOT-MSS-IN
-A FORWARD -j OSSBOT-MSS-FWD
-A OUTPUT -j OSSBOT-MSS-OUT
-A OSSBOT-MSS-FWD -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --set-mss 1300
-A OSSBOT-MSS-IN ! -i lo -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --set-mss 1300
-A OSSBOT-MSS-OUT ! -o lo -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --set-mss 1300
